# ISecuritizeOnRamp
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/securitize/ISecuritizeOnRamp.sol)

**Title:**
ISecuritizeOnRamp

Minimal interface for Securitize's per-fund on-ramp (subscription) contract, registered
in the DSToken's service registry under id 16384.

Subscriptions are operator-authorized: an EXCHANGE/ISSUER key signs an EIP-712
`ExecutePreApprovedTransaction` whose `data` is an internal `subscribe(...)` call. The
on-ramp verifies the signer's role, pulls the liquidity token from the investor wallet,
forwards it (minus fee) to the fund custodian, and MINTS the DSToken to the investor in the
same transaction. There is no on-chain off-ramp — redemptions settle off-chain.


## Functions
### executePreApprovedTransaction

Executes a Securitize-signed pre-approved transaction (a subscription). The signature
must recover to an EXCHANGE/ISSUER role holder; the on-ramp then runs `txData.data`.


```solidity
function executePreApprovedTransaction(
    bytes calldata signature,
    ExecutePreApprovedTransaction calldata txData
)
    external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`signature`|`bytes`|The operator's EIP-712 signature over `txData`|
|`txData`|`ExecutePreApprovedTransaction`|The pre-approved transaction (destination, `subscribe` calldata, investor nonce)|


### liquidityToken

The liquidity (stablecoin) token the on-ramp pulls on subscription.


```solidity
function liquidityToken() external view returns (address);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`address`|The liquidity token address|


### custodianWallet

The fund custodian wallet that receives subscription liquidity.


```solidity
function custodianWallet() external view returns (address);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`address`|The fund custodian wallet address|


### navProvider

The Securitize single-source NAV provider the on-ramp prices subscriptions with.


```solidity
function navProvider() external view returns (address);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`address`|The NAV provider address|


### nonceByInvestor

Per-investor nonce consumed by `executePreApprovedTransaction`.


```solidity
function nonceByInvestor(string calldata investorId) external view returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`investorId`|`string`|The Securitize investor identifier|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The next nonce for `investorId`|


## Structs
### ExecutePreApprovedTransaction
Operator-signed authorization for the on-ramp to execute `data` against `destination`
(in practice an internal `subscribe(...)`), bound to an investor nonce.


```solidity
struct ExecutePreApprovedTransaction {
    string senderInvestor;
    address destination;
    bytes data;
    uint256 nonce;
}
```
